historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_3yr_cagr, moderated toward FY2027 guidance midpoint (5-6%)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Shareholders' equity CAGR is not usable here: ADP is an aggressive repurchaser whose book value swung from a $679.8M DEFICIT (FY2018) to $6,031.2M (FY2026) purely on buyback/dividend timing versus retained earnings, so equity CAGR (19.8% 3yr / 1.2% 5yr) is an artifact of the buyback cadence, not of the underlying business. Owner-FCF CAGR (8.4% 3yr / 11.9% 5yr, on the SBC- and interest-income-adjusted series) and revenue CAGR (6.8% 3yr / 7.9% 5yr) are the reliable anchors; selected_growth_rate uses revenue, moderated to management's own FY2027 guidance (5-6%) rather than the higher historical average, since FY2026's 7% growth was flagged by management itself as a strong year the FY2027 guide is normalizing down from.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2027 guidance (5-6% revenue, +70-90bps EBIT margin, 9-11% EPS growth) decelerating gradually to a mature ~3.5-4%; margin ramps to ~29.5% on AI efficiency, Lyric HCM scale, and a growing high-margin client-funds interest revenue mix.
scenario_narratives.bull: AI-driven efficiency and Lyric HCM enterprise wins sustain above-guidance growth; client funds interest revenue outgrows the 3.7% yield guide; retention holds despite Paychex-Paycor and cloud-native competition.
scenario_narratives.bear: A faster/deeper Fed rate-cutting cycle reverses the client funds interest revenue tailwind while competitive and platform-migration pressure slows bookings and compresses margin before AI efficiency can offset it.

valuation_philosophy.summary: ADP is valued as a mature, highly recurring, capital-light services compounder with an unusual (for a services company) interest-rate-sensitive revenue stream layered on top of the core payroll/HCM business. The valuation is built on owner FCF (SBC and corporate interest income stripped, share count held flat since buybacks are the funding mechanism for that flat count) over a 10-year horizon because margins are still on a genuine, management-guided upward path rather than already mature. Client funds interest revenue is treated as ordinary, already-embedded revenue -- not modeled as a bank's net interest margin -- because ADP does not take credit risk on the funds; the float asset and obligation net to zero in net debt.
key_risks_to_valuation: Client funds interest revenue reversal if the Fed cuts rates faster/further than guided -- this is the single largest swing factor between scenarios
Competitive share loss to Paychex-Paycor (larger combined scale), Rippling, Dayforce and Paylocity in the mid-market
Multi-year Lyric HCM platform migration execution risk for large enterprise clients
Cybersecurity/data-breach exposure given the sensitive payroll and personal data ADP holds for tens of millions of workers
US employment levels and small-business formation rates drive the underlying payroll/PEO volume the model assumes keeps growing

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 188.16-294.35
data_sources.financials: SEC XBRL companyfacts API, CIK0000008670 (us-gaap: Revenues, CostsAndExpenses, NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities, PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPlantAndEquipment, PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets, PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquired, ShareBasedCompensation, InvestmentIncomeInterest, EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperations, CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue, LongTermDebtNoncurrent, DebtCurrent, WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding, PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock, FundsHeldForClients); cross-checked against ./research/ADP/Reports/ADP_Metrics.csv and ADP.duckdb core_metrics/kpis where overlapping (all matched)
data_sources.qualitative: ./research/ADP/Reports/ADP_Analysis.json (2026-09-25), including FY2027 guidance issued 2026-07-29 with Q4/FY2026 results

inputs.sbc_source: SEC XBRL us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation (cash-flow add-back), CIK0000008670, FY2026 10-K (period 2025-07-01/2026-06-30) = $242.6M; matches ADP_Metrics.csv StockBasedComp. ADP does not separately disclose cash tax withheld on net-share settlement (low-SBC filer, ~1.1% of revenue, no PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation tag found in companyfacts); sbc_incl_equity_taxes therefore equals the cash-flow add-back only -- immaterial given SBC's small scale relative to revenue.
inputs.share_count_basis: fully diluted weighted-average, FY2026 10-K (us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding) = 403.3M. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the owner-FCF build (section 1 of owner-fcf.md), so charging both the SBC expense and a rising share count would double-count. FY2026 buyback cash of $2,083.3M (up from $1,280.5M FY2025, per us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock) shows ADP is a genuine repurchaser funding the flat count, not merely diluting and hoping buybacks catch up.
inputs.wacc_rationale: 8.5% for a large-cap, investment-grade (A-rated), low-beta (~0.9), highly recurring-revenue US services business. Built from a ~4.2% risk-free rate (10-year UST, Sep-2026) plus a ~4.8% levered ERP given ADP's very high revenue retention (~92% Employer Services) and mature capital structure; consistent with peers in the payroll/HCM space (Paychex, comparable large-cap software/services names run 8-9.5%).
inputs.lease_treatment: not material -- ADP's operating leases (office space) are small relative to the balance sheet and cash flows; no separate lease adjustment applied (US company, section 7 adaptations not triggered).
inputs.nci_treatment: none -- ADP has no reported noncontrolling interests.
inputs.notes: ROUTING: confirmed via .claude/skills/dcf-methods/SKILL.md -- ADP is a normal operating company (payroll/HCM services with a PEO segment); 'client funds interest revenue' (~$1.35B FY2026, guided $1.54-1.56B FY2027 per Analysis JSON) is a genuine, already-embedded REVENUE line (ADP invests client payroll float and reports the yield as revenue, not as a bank's net interest margin) -- it is NOT modeled as a deposit-taker/bank, because ADP does not intermediate credit risk on client funds the way a bank does with deposits; the float is a pass-through timing asset (FundsHeldForClients) with a matching client-funds-obligations liability that nets to zero in net debt. Routed to the standard owner-FCF DCF, 10-year horizon (references/owner-fcf.md). CapEx and FreeCashFlow are NULL in ADP_Metrics.csv (not XBRL-tagged as a single line) -- sourced directly from SEC XBRL companyfacts (CIK0000008670): total capex = us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPlantAndEquipment (PP&E, $196.6M FY2026) + us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets (capitalized software additions, $468.5M FY2026) = $665.1M; confirmed this excludes M&A by cross-checking against the separate us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquired tag ($22.8M FY2026; $1,165.1M FY2025 = WorkForce Software close). Interest income of $371.0M (us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInterest, 'Other (income) expense, net') is corporate treasury interest on non-client cash/short-term investments -- distinct from client funds interest revenue which stays inside revenue/EBITDA -- and is stripped per section 1(b) even though net debt is slightly positive (net debt $735.0M, i.e. not net-cash-positive by the >1x-FCF rule) because it is a real non-operating income stream unrelated to the operating flows being capitalized; conservative and immaterial either way given the small net debt position. Effective cash tax rate has been stable at 22.5-23.2% for eight straight years (no valuation-allowance release or one-off credit) -- held flat at 23% with no ramp needed. 10-year horizon chosen because EBITDA margin is still on a genuine, guided upward path (26.7% FY23 -> 26.9% FY26, management guiding +70-90bps further EBIT margin expansion in FY2027 from AI efficiency (ADP Assist/'The Zone') and a rising client-funds interest yield (3.4% -> 3.7% guided)), not yet at a mature flat margin.

bear.narrative: The Fed cuts rates faster and deeper than the market expects, reversing the client funds interest revenue tailwind (guided to $1.54-1.56B FY2027 on a 3.7% yield -- a rate-cutting cycle compresses this high-margin, ~6%-of-revenue line directly, per the Analysis JSON's top-rated financial and macro risks). Simultaneously, Paychex's larger scale post-Paycor acquisition and modern cloud-native entrants (Rippling, Paylocity, Dayforce) erode new business bookings and pressure pricing in the mid-market, while the multi-year Lyric HCM platform migration causes client disruption and elevated near-term costs without yet delivering efficiency gains. Revenue growth stalls near 2%, margin compresses initially as the interest-revenue tailwind reverses before AI cost efficiency partly offsets it later in the horizon.

base.narrative: FY2027 guidance (5-6% revenue growth, +70-90bps EBIT margin, EPS +9-11%) decelerating gradually toward a long-run ~3.5-4% (payroll/HCM is recurring but not immune to a maturing US labor market). EBITDA margin ramps from 26.9% (FY2026 actual) to ~29.5% as AI Assist/'The Zone' efficiency gains and Lyric HCM scale economics compound, and as client funds interest revenue (guided to $1.54-1.56B FY2027 from $1.35B FY2026, on rising balances and yield) keeps mixing in at a structurally higher margin than the core payroll-processing business. Capex stays elevated (~3% of revenue) reflecting continued heavy software capitalization for Lyric HCM and AI tooling. Cash tax rate held flat at the stable, non-abnormal 23% effective rate ADP has run for eight straight years.

bull.narrative: AI Assist and 'The Zone' deliver efficiency gains faster and deeper than guided, compounding with record Employer Services bookings ($2.2B FY2026, +6% YoY, top of range) and Lyric HCM's enterprise momentum (live clients +94% YoY, pipeline +50%, >70% new-logo wins) to sustain above-guidance revenue growth. Client funds interest revenue grows faster on both higher balances (accelerating payroll growth) and a higher blended yield than the 3.7% FY2027 guide, adding a high-margin tailwind on top of core operating leverage. Competitive intensity (Paychex-Paycor, Rippling, Dayforce) fails to dent ADP's ~92% retention. Margin expands toward 32% as the AI-driven productivity story broadens past FY2027.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: House default nudged toward bear (20% vs 15% default) because ADP's own risk disclosure names interest-rate-cycle exposure as a HIGH-severity financial and macro risk simultaneously -- a rate-cutting cycle is a real, identifiable near-term catalyst (not a generic risk) that would compress a high-margin, fast-growing revenue line the base case leans on for margin expansion. Bull trimmed to 30% because it requires several things to go right together (AI efficiency ahead of guidance, Lyric HCM momentum sustaining, AND a still-favorable rate/yield environment) rather than one clean catalyst.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
